participants.bio: Architect, enthusiastic dinner host, and an unapologetic collector of very small bowls.

participants.name: Eli
participants.bio: Bookshop regular. Makes excellent pasta and has a wildly overambitious reading list.

participants.name: Theo
participants.bio: A designer who turns an ordinary Saturday into a very loosely planned adventure.

memories.text: I want a long-term monogamous relationship and have time to date thoughtfully.
I care about meaningful work but protect evenings for friends and a partner. Separate accounts and proportional shared costs work for me.
I want affection and regular time together, with room for independent interests and private messages.
Close friendships matter. I am comfortable with an ex being a friend when boundaries and introductions are clear.
I want to discuss disagreements directly, take a short break when heated, and come back to work it out.
I am secular, want children eventually, and can accept different beliefs if neither person pressures the other.
My mother may need to live with me; I have not yet explained what care I would expect a partner to provide.
